integrity: Analytical proof with independent exact-rational finite LP checks; no extrapolation from enumeration to the all-size result.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two distinct floor-quota blocks; continuous-chamber measure-zero statement requires positive-dimensional quota chamber and fixed sum of residues.
Optimal envy formula and uniqueness only for two blocks of size two and two round-ups.
Fixed index convention for equal residues.
Related general-purpose flow and optimization algorithms exist; novelty concerns symbolic structure, generic geometry and unique optimizer; possible unindexed priority.
title: Two-block apportionment has a thin envy-free locus and a unique four-party minimum-envy lottery
